Synthetic local media for the skin importer and Electron smoke test. No downloaded or personal content.

The two-frame APNG/WebP fixtures have a transparent center and alternate border colors at 320 × 200. The one-second videos use FFmpeg testsrc2 at 320 × 200 / 12 fps, encoded with H.264/yuv420p and VP9 without audio.

clock.gif: local seeded procedural sky, 960×320, 24 frames, generated by the companion design-engine tool; no third-party artwork.
